_comment: SpaceMiT K3 three-model workload (same periods/windows/instances as networks_k1_mb_3model_4hz.json). Machine mapping: cpu_p = X100 cluster = CPUs 0-7, cpu_e = A100 cluster = CPUs 8-15 (16 CPUs, shared memory). Each type is profiled separately (profile_hw rvv_k3_x100 / rvv_k3_a100) at widths 1/2/4/8 (topo_0, topo_0_1, topo_0_1_2_3, topo_0_1_2_3_4_5_6_7 -- width-relative tags, identical for both types); shard mode never mixes types in one dispatch. No IME, so enable_impls is off. Timer is 24 MHz.
_topo_comment: topo_tag_override is false so each width block is costed from its own N-hart profile (topo tag derived from the combination); true would charge every block the 1-hart time.
_instances_comment: num_instances pinned (as in the K1 spec) so solves stay comparable.
_comment_ime: Plan 2 variant of networks_k3_mb_3model.json: identical workload, but cpu_e (A100, CPUs 8-15) is priced with the ime_k3_a100 backend (IME vmadot convs/linear + RVV-tuned maxpool, zvl1024b). Compare against the baseline spec, which prices cpu_e with rvv_k3_a100.
_comment_singletons: Plan 3 control: identical to networks_k3_mb_3model_ime.json but singletons mode (every dispatch on exactly one core, no sharding). Baseline for the split variant.
